builder.subtitle: Compose the index from one or more collections, each with one or more OCR models.

success.updated: Index updated — rebuild in progress, follow the progress in Tasks.
success.queued: Indexing added to the queue — follow the progress in Tasks.
success.updateQueued: Update added to the queue — only new or modified pages will be reindexed.
success.fullRebuildQueued: Full rebuild added to the queue — the index stays available until it finishes.
success.pausing: Pausing — can be resumed from Tasks.

list.emptyDesc: No index generated — create one from one or more transcribed collections.

list.coverageStale_other: {{val}} indexed pages no longer exist in the OCR output (files deleted since).

list.coverageFreshnessScanned: Figures come from an actual re-read of the OCR folders.
